text:
jess: Customer reported tool call payloads arriving truncated in streaming responses — args arrive as partial JSON and the tool bails with schema validation. Example from their logs:

nora: Received error: Tool 'charge_customer' args parse error: Unexpected end of JSON at position 182

jess: Reproduced quickly against hosted API; see similar behavior when client disconnects/reconnects mid-SSE chunk. Payload delivered to backend sometimes looks like: {"amount":100,"currency":"USD","metadata":{
 (cut)

devon: Can you paste the exact SSE output? Which proxy sits in front of Redwood? Any intermediaries? :eyes:

jess: Pasted below. Customer uses an API gateway + Cloudflare. SSE capture:
```
event: message
data: {"tool":"charge_customer","args":{"amount":100,"currency":"USD","id":"cus_123","note":"invoice #"}}

// next chunk (delayed)

data: "12345","reason":"card_declined"}}
```

sara: That looks like two chunks got split and the boundary overlapped JSON braces. Could be Cloudflare buffering + client chunked transfer. Any repro steps?

jess: Steps I ran:
1) curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream" \n  --data-binary @payload.json
2) Interrupt halfway (CTRL+C) then resume a second later. Repeat. Sometimes server receives partial object.

nora: We're on Node 18 using fetch with a ReadableStream piped; not intentionally cancelling. Occurs on high-latency mobile networks.

devon: Possible mismatch in how we reassemble SSE data for tool calls. Runtime expects a complete `data:` block per event. If a proxy splits mid-data and later merges with another event, our parser may not stitch correctly. Need raw bytes at ingress for debugging.

sara: I'll enable raw-ingest logging for that tenant for 1 hour. devon, can you add defensive parsing: if JSON.parse fails with Unexpected end of JSON, hold buffer for 500ms and attempt reassembly before returning schema error?

devon: Can do. Add a small grace window and attempt to rejoin adjacent `data:` lines. Will add metrics to track any latency impact.

jess: Customer ok with trial patch. I'll schedule a canary on Dedicated for that tenant.

nora: Thanks, we'll send a pcap of the mobile repro later.

ops-bot: Scheduled raw-ingest logging for tenant 'acme-inc' until 2026-02-15T15:10:00Z :white_check_mark:

michael: FYI Cloudflare has a known SSE chunking optimization. Repro'd locally with `ncat --send-only` forcing 50-byte chunks. Confirmed parser fails when boundary splits inside a multibyte UTF-8 char too.

devon: Good catch — will add unicode-safe reassembly as well. I'll open a PR with tests + canary config. ETA EOD.

jess: Marking in-progress. I'll update after canary. :v:
